Net effect on CAD (Cath) risk: raises risk (Typical chest pain, EF-TTE (ejection fraction), Atypical chest pain, Non-anginal chest pain, Regional wall-motion abnormality, ST elevation, Q wave, T-wave inversion, ST depression, Bundle branch block, Left ventricular hypertrophy, Poor R-wave progression, Pulse rate, Systolic murmur, Diastolic murmur, Functional class, Congestive heart failure, Low-threshold angina, Valvular heart disease, Exertional chest pain).

Blood vessels & lipids: location of a contributing risk factor - NOT the location of disease. Net effect on CAD (Cath) risk: lowers risk (Hypertension, Triglycerides, HDL cholesterol, Systolic blood pressure, Weak peripheral pulse, Family history of CAD, Dyslipidaemia, LDL cholesterol).
Pancreas / glucose metabolism: location of a contributing risk factor - NOT the location of disease. Net effect on CAD (Cath) risk: lowers risk (Fasting blood sugar, Diabetes mellitus).
